requirements.evidence: Routes match the contract (routes/web.php:19-46: guest login/register, auth logout, auth+verified home, throttle:6,1 on password.email and verification). Login/Register implement the required public properties and submit() with Password::defaults, Registered, session()->regenerate(), redirectIntended (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:22-45, app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:26-57). Reset view has a single name="email" input (resources/views/auth/reset-password.blade.php:17) and rotates the remember_token (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:33). Locale pins are in .env.example and phpunit.xml:22-23, and lang/en|pt_BR/ui.php exist. Deductions: the verification resend flashes the raw 'verification-link-sent' string (EmailVerificationController.php:39) which the view prints untranslated, and login rejects mixed-case e-mail instead of normalising it (Login.php:27).

conventions.evidence: Password::defaults is configured once in app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:30; controllers redirect with named routes (LogoutController.php:18, NewPasswordController.php:41) and every view link uses route(); a layout exists for the full-page Livewire components (layouts/app.blade.php:1-23); migrations/fillable untouched. Deviations: Livewire validation is inline in submit() rather than #[Validate] on the properties (Login.php:26-30, Register.php:38-42); five views copy-paste the same Bulma field markup instead of an anonymous Blade component; no tests despite the test-first rule; only CHANGELOG.md:12 updated in docs; leftover commented import in app/Models/User.php:5.

security.evidence: All input is validated server-side before use (Login.php:26-30, Register.php:38-42, NewPasswordController.php:22-26, PasswordResetLinkController.php:17-19); Auth uses the password hash and regenerates the session (Login.php:32-42, Register.php:52-54); logout invalidates the session and regenerates the CSRF token (LogoutController.php:12-16); login/register/verification are rate-limited (routes/web.php:24,41,45); verification.verify is signed and EmailVerificationRequest performs the id/hash ownership check, so a tampered id yields 403; remember_token is rotated on reset (NewPasswordController.php:33); explicit mass-assignment fields on User::create (Register.php:44-48); all output uses {{ }} with no {!! !!}; no secrets beyond the contract-mandated input properties.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files at all (nothing under tests/ or any *Test.php/Pest file). There is no happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call or tamper coverage for login, registration, logout, home, forgot/reset password, e-mail verification or localization; the pt_BR test locale is only pinned in phpunit.xml:22-23 and never asserted.

simplicity.evidence: No speculative abstractions: the change reuses the Password broker, RateLimiter, EmailVerificationRequest and framework middleware. But the same label/control/input/@error block is duplicated across five views (resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:13-33, register.blade.php:7-35, auth/forgot-password.blade.php:22-30, auth/reset-password.blade.php:14-45) instead of one Blade component.

readability.evidence: Small, clearly named methods (Login::ensureIsNotRateLimited/throttleKey, EmailVerificationController::notice/verify/send) and straightforward views consistent with Laravel idioms. Minor blemishes: dead commented import at app/Models/User.php:5, and layouts/app.blade.php:6 renders "PegaFila - PegaFila" because config('app.name') and ui.layout.title are both PegaFila.

scope.evidence: Every changed file serves the task: new auth controllers/Livewire components/views, the shared layout, lang/en|pt_BR/ui.php, locale pins, and the two existing views converted to the layout plus translations, which requirements 8-9 explicitly demand; the only extras are harmless route names 'welcome'/'bulma.test' and the CHANGELOG entry (CHANGELOG.md:12).

issues.explanation: The change ships zero Pest/PHPUnit tests for any new behaviour, violating the project's test-first rule and leaving the mandatory unauthorized-call and tamper coverage for the Livewire actions absent.

The resend handler flashes the raw string 'verification-link-sent' and the view echoes session('status') directly, so users see that literal token instead of a translated message in both pt_BR and en, breaking the requirement that all screen text come from the lang files.

The lowercase validation rule rejects valid mixed-case e-mail input such as 'John@Example.com' instead of normalising it, so those users cannot log in even though the task only asks for strict e-mail validation.
Validation rules are declared inline in submit() rather than on the public properties with #[Validate], which conventions.md names as the project's Livewire pattern.
The identical Bulma label/control/error markup is copy-pasted across the auth views instead of being extracted into an anonymous Blade component as the UI conventions ask.
Only the changelog is updated; the README/docs that conventions require to stay in sync for structural changes are untouched despite the new auth surface.
The old commented-out '// use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\MustVerifyEmail;' import is left in place next to the real import added at line 7, leaving dead code.
The title concatenates config('app.name') and __('ui.layout.title'), both 'PegaFila', so every page title reads 'PegaFila - PegaFila'.

review.summary: The change implements the full pt-BR session-auth surface (Livewire login/register, logout, home, password reset, e-mail verification) with sound validation, throttling, session hardening and localization files, and it largely matches the route/contract requirements. It cannot be approved as is: there is not a single test in the diff (a hard project rule, and auth needs unauthorized/tamper coverage), and the verification resend flashes the raw 'verification-link-sent' token onto the page in both locales, with some smaller Livewire convention and consistency issues.
